uutiset.t: BlackRock’s HPS Seeks Billions for New Direct Lending Fund
uutiset.s: HPS Investment Partners LLC recently met with investors in New York to launch its latest flagship direct-lending fund, betting that institutional backers will keep piling billions into the leading players in private credit after a turbulent year.

uutiset.t: SpiceJet Approves 55 Billion Rupee Fundraising to Aid Turnaround
uutiset.s: SpiceJet Ltd.’s board has approved a proposal to raise up to 55 billion rupees ($588 million), in a move that could provide a much-needed boost to the cash-strapped Indian airline.

uutiset.t: BASF’s Evonik Chase Poses Test for Potential Merz Successor
uutiset.s: BASF SE’s bid to consolidate Germany’s struggling chemicals industry with a takeover of Evonik Industries AG looks set to join the ranks of politically-charged deals taking shape across Europe this year.

uutiset.t: MUFG: Reverse Yankees Are About 20% of Europe Corporates
uutiset.s: MUFG EMEA Capital Markets Co-Head Fabianna del Canto says the percentage of reverse yankees, or debt issued by US companies in foreign currencies, has ballooned to around 20% of the European corporate market, with clients now looking to issue further afield markets like Australia's. uutiset.t: Kenya Parks $1.9 Billion Vodacom-Safaricom Cash in Bonds Pending Court Ruling
uutiset.s: Kenya has invested some of the $1.9 billion that Vodacom Group Ltd. paid for a stake in the country’s biggest company in government securities as it awaits the outcome of a court petition opposing the transaction, its treasury secretary said.

uutiset.t: UK Inflation Accelerates to Highest Level in a Year
uutiset.s: Consumer prices rose 3.6% from a year earlier after a surge in energy bills and motor fuel costs, the Office for National Statistics said on Wednesday. It was in line with economists’ expectations. Bloomberg's Sam Unsted breaks down the numbers. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Bloomberg Global Credit Forum: Where Do Debt Markets Go From Here? Live Updates
uutiset.s: With credit markets at an inflection point, the industry’s most influential voices gather in London for Bloomberg’s Global Credit Forum 2026.

uutiset.t: Alstom Falls After Expectations of Equity Raise to Reduce Debt
uutiset.s: Alstom SA declined after the troubled French trainmaker lowered expectations for asset sales to help pay down debt, putting the possibility of a rights issue in view.

uutiset.t: Xi-Trump-Putin Trilateral: A Great Power Stitch-Up?
uutiset.s: Trump, China’s Xi and Russia’s Putin will meet for a three-way summit this week. It’s an unprecedented meeting that’s drawn comparisons with the summit at Yalta near the end of World War II — and raised concerns of a great power stitch-up. Rebecca Choong Wilkins has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Eurobank to Buy 65% of Bulgaria’s Fibank for €650 Million
uutiset.s: Greece’s Eurobank agreed to buy a majority stake in First Investment Bank in Bulgaria, setting in motion a mandatory offer for the rest in a deal that would create the Balkan country’s biggest lender by assets.
